name: odnoklassniki-mcp
description: Odnoklassniki (social): me, publish_text, read_comments, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to

platform_mcp_odnoklassniki_application_k.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ODNOKLASSNIKI_APPLICATION_KEY
platform_mcp_odnoklassniki_application_k.description: Public key of your OK application (application_key, from the app registration e-mail / app settings at https://ok.ru/app/setup).

platform_mcp_odnoklassniki_application_s.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ODNOKLASSNIKI_APPLICATION_SECRET_KEY
platform_mcp_odnoklassniki_application_s.description: Secret key of the same application (application_secret_key). Only used to compute sig; never sent.

platform_mcp_odnoklassniki_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ODNOKLASSNIKI_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_odnoklassniki_access_token.description: User access_token with VALUABLE_ACCESS and GROUP_CONTENT, from the OAuth flow (https://apiok.ru/ext/oauth/) or the app's permanent 'Вечный access_token' in the app settings. Sent in the POST body, excluded from sig as the convention requires.

platform_mcp_odnoklassniki_group_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ODNOKLASSNIKI_GROUP_ID
platform_mcp_odnoklassniki_group_id.description: Numeric id (gid) of the OK group you administer; posts, comments and statistics are for this group's topics (needs the GROUP_CONTENT permission).

tools.name: me
tools.description: users.getCurrentUser: the user behind the access_token (uid, name, locale, pic_*).

tools.name: publish_text
tools.description: mediatopic.post (type GROUP_THEME) publishes a text topic in the configured group (GROUP_CONTENT). OK answers with the new topic id as a bare JSON string, which the runtime cannot map to a record, so this tool returns only status=published; read the id from the group feed (it is also the discussionId for read_comments). reply_to is ignored.

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: discussions.getComments for a group topic (discussionType GROUP_TOPIC, discussionId = the topic id). Paging is by `anchor`: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: mediatopic.deleteTopic (VALUABLE_ACCESS): returns {restore_id, success}; restore_id can undo it with mediatopic.restoreTopic.

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: group.getStatTopic (GROUP_CONTENT + VALUABLE_ACCESS): reach, reach_earned/own, engagement, likes, comments, reshares, views, content_opens, link_clicks, video_plays, negatives, complaints for one group topic.
